## Summary

I implemented a native Mistral AI connector for the Semantic Kernel Python SDK, following the existing provider abstraction (modeled closely on the `azure_ai_inference` connector). All new files live under `semantic_kernel/connectors/ai/mistral_ai/` — no test files were touched.

### Files created

1. **`services/mistral_ai_chat_completion.py`** — `MistralAIChatCompletion(ChatCompletionClientBase)`
   - Constructor accepts `ai_model_id`, `service_id`, `api_key`, `async_client`, `env_file_path` (plus optional `env_file_encoding`).
   - Resolves `ai_model_id`/`api_key` from `MISTRALAI_CHAT_MODEL_ID` / `MISTRALAI_API_KEY` via a `MistralAISettings` object.
   - Raises `ServiceInitializationError` when the model ID (or, when no client is supplied, the API key) can't be resolved.
   - `get_chat_message_contents` returns `list[ChatMessageContent]`, wrapping client failures in `ServiceResponseException`.
   - `get_streaming_chat_message_contents` is an async generator yielding streaming content lists, skipping empty-choice chunks and raising `ServiceResponseException` on errors.
   - `get_prompt_execution_settings_class` returns `MistralAIChatPromptExecutionSettings`.
